title: Sprint 2 - enforcement gap contract
description: SPRINT BRIEF. Build the single source of truth the directive inversion keys off: a typed EnforcementGap contract emitted by every enforcement point in the runtime. Today enforcement facts are scattered - CloseoutGateGap objects exist only inside applyRequiredCloseoutGatePolicy (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 164-195 and 1266-1337), reservation and policy violations are thrown as BorealError with ad hoc detail shapes (packages/agent-runtime/src/reservations.ts lines 64-76), and blocked status is derived but the reasons are not reified (packages/work-engine/src/work.ts lines 310-325). The directive registry then re-predicts these facts with its appliesTo matcher, which is the duplication this epic removes. Scope: define the gap-code contract, emit gaps on both failure and success paths of close, reserve, claim and verify, and property-test that every policy violation carries a gap code. This sprint changes no directive behavior; it only makes enforcement legible. Done when the runtime exposes gaps as typed data agents and the compiler can consume.
